criteria.title: Segmented frame-group ordering
criteria.acceptance: Global frame/record/segment context and CRC/SHA chain; INTENT file fsync before sensor callback; no missed/duplicate admitted frame

criteria.title: Truthful segment/session closure
criteria.acceptance: File+directory synced exclusive seals, no append afterseal; local send vsAPexecution separate; incomplete group never complete

criteria.title: Filesystem and transmission faults
criteria.acceptance: Shortwrite/EIO/ENOSPC/filefsync/dirsync/missingnext/sendunknown preserve validprefix and diagnostics; no fabricated SENT

criteria.title: Bounded exact stage/cost records
criteria.acceptance: All exact per-frame timing rows stream; bounded aggregate state and exact maxima, no unbounded append/flush arrays

criteria.title: Long-session clock state
criteria.acceptance: Morethan1024 exchanges, bounded pending/tombstone maps and complete durable events; no IDreuse

criteria.title: Terminal lifecycle
criteria.acceptance: Firstclosed elapsed immutable, walljumps no deadlineextension; oldgenerationcallbacks fenced; reopen only verifiedclosure/durablehistory; no restored lease

criteria.title: Provider descriptor
criteria.acceptance: Expected/observed binary/model/config/endpoint context match; null/newcandidate fails validation; no structuralvalidation as auth or flightgrant

criteria.title: Admission and real task budget
criteria.acceptance: 20GiB entry,10GiB+256MiB floor/15sforecast; deny undefined bounds/underbudget/overflow; no real hostdiskfill

criteria.title: Independent cold integrity and composition
criteria.acceptance: Receiver checks complete raw/segments/membership/context/calleranchor; clock durable-sink→journal tested; integrity notsourceauthenticity

criteria.title: Isolation and bounded verification
criteria.acceptance: Old frozen/source/candidate/ENDURE and historicalreceipts unchanged; noAP/Android/hostservices/install/sign; own classscratch cleaned
